title: Bourbon Street then and now
summary: How Bourbon Street changed, traffic, tourists and T-shirts; his current spot the Mason.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: But, uh, I was just wondering about the experience of working at Bourbon Street.

Well, Bourbon Street at one time was a good place to play, but it was a good place to go. But the only time I go on Bourbon Street now is to work. Because Bourbon Street, and you know, like the place I play, there's a different type of people coming that plays. Because whenever we play we have people who are well dressed. They sit down and drink and clap to the music. We keep a pack house. Where some of the other places, they're dancing, customers not buying anything, they're dancing. Hanging outside, doing a lot of nasty talk. So at one time, it didn't.
So when you were working at Valentich years ago?

Bourbon Street was all the good. And then the automobile used to travel up and down Bourbon Street. And I think that was one of the worst things they could have done to stop the traffic on Bourbon Street. Because that would keep the people out of the street with automobiles running.

And if a person come on Bourbon Street to spend money, the automobile's not gonna stop him coming out there. He's coming out to hear some music. He's going home. But these kids, they come down here with no money, and they just walk the street. Yeah. Doing all kinds of funny things on the street.
So you think the crowds have changed since you were working at Bourbon Street?

Yeah. People used to come on Bourbon Street to hear music. But now they come out there and they got T-shirts and they're selling, and they're selling all kinds of pornography and things like that. If I didn't have to play on Bourbon Street, I wouldn't even go down there now.
Where were you playing on Bourbon Street?
I've been there on and off now for 22 years. I just went back about six months ago, after being off a year and a half from there.
